grammar.title: Anyway, in any case with 反正
grammar.pattern: 反正 + 主语 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 反正 (fǎnzhèng) means "anyway, in any case" — it shows that no matter what happens, the outcome or attitude stays the same. It's common in casual speech to dismiss other possibilities.

grammar.title: Each other, mutually with 互相
grammar.explanation: 互相 (hùxiāng) means "each other, mutually" — it goes before a verb to show that two or more people do the same action to one another. It's often used with verbs like 帮助, 认识, 关心.

sentences.zh: 他们互相认识很多年了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen hùxiāng rènshi hěn duō nián le.
sentences.en: They've known each other for many years.
Good friends should care about each other.
